summary: The proof is complete and correct. Full Q- and R-tails give b=m and d=k, so the explicit constraints Omega=2t-b-d>=0 and 9t=2(1+m+k) imply m+k<=4/5. In the eta=0 branch, k>1-q^2 with m=q^2 gives m+k>1. In each of the eta=1 and eta=2 branches, 5q>3, q>0, and 2k>3q^2+2q-1 give 2(m+k)>5q^2+2q-1=2+(5q-3)(q+1)>2, again yielding m+k>1. Thus every full/full system is infeasible independently of its labels. The accepted reduced-list count is exactly 34928 full/full classes for each of the three eta values, so the eliminated-system count is exactly 3*34928=104784.
